plainTranslation: A's drive meets B's depth and power. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your depth, control, and willingness to be exposed. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Where it falls flat is leaving the power idle, or letting the intensity simmer into friction instead of action. You may feel the charge and never quite channel it, so the potential stays unused or turns into low-grade resentment.
advice: Aim the energy on purpose, and keep it pointed at what you actually want. This one turns from charged to genuinely powerful when you put the intensity to work rather than letting it work on you.
